_comment: Vehicle parameters for fsds_lite. Defaults approximate the FSDS TechnionCar
(255 kg, ~27 m/s top speed, 25 deg max steer, 1.8 x 1.0 m collision box,
CoG 25 cm up) with a ~40 Nm FS-style single-cylinder engine, a 4-speed
automatic gearbox, a PhysX-style limited-slip rear diff (diff_type: open,
limited_slip or locked) and per-wheel spin, so wheelspin and lock-up happen.
Top speed is max_rpm in top gear, so change gearing or max_rpm to move it. Nothing here is calibrated against our car or the RC
testbed yet - copy this file, edit it, and pass it with --vehicle. Units are
SI (kg, m, N, s, rad, Nm). See fsds_lite/vehicle.py for what each term does.
